product_type: Front bumper assembly: the exterior front-end module of a passenger car, combining bumper cover, energy-absorbing structure, integrated front fog and direction indicator lamps, and ultrasonic parking sensors
mounting_location: Vehicle front end, across the full width below the bonnet/headlamps, attached to the front body structure (longitudinal members/crash boxes) and front-end carrier

functions.name: low-speed impact protection
functions.description: Bumper beam and energy absorber absorb and distribute energy in low-speed frontal impacts to limit damage to the vehicle front structure and components.

functions.name: pedestrian lower-leg impact protection
functions.description: EPP foam energy absorber behind the fascia absorbs impact energy to reduce lower-leg loading in a pedestrian collision.

functions.name: exterior styling and aerodynamic closure
functions.description: Painted bumper cover and lower grille close off the front end, define the exterior appearance and manage airflow.

functions.name: front fog lamp (front fog illumination)
functions.description: Integrated LED front fog lamps provide illumination of the road ahead in fog or reduced visibility.

functions.name: front direction indicator (turn signalling)
functions.description: Integrated LED front direction indicator lamps signal the driver's intention to change direction to other road users.

functions.name: parking-assist obstacle detection
functions.description: Ultrasonic sensors mounted in the bumper detect obstacles ahead of the vehicle during low-speed manoeuvring and parking.

parts.name: Bumper cover (fascia)
parts.role: Outer visible skin of the front end; carries grille, lamps and sensors; styling and aerodynamic closure

parts.name: Energy absorber
parts.role: Absorbs impact energy for pedestrian lower-leg protection and low-speed impacts; located between fascia and beam

parts.name: Bumper beam (reinforcement)
parts.role: Structural cross member transferring low-speed impact loads into the vehicle body structure

parts.name: Lower grille
parts.role: Closes the lower front opening while permitting cooling airflow; styling element

parts.name: Front fog lamps
parts.role: Provide front fog illumination; housed in the bumper

parts.name: Front direction indicator lamps
parts.role: Provide front turn signalling; housed in the bumper

parts.name: Ultrasonic parking sensors
parts.role: Detect obstacles in front of the vehicle for parking assistance

parts.name: Wiring harness
parts.role: Electrical connection of parking sensors (and lamps) to the vehicle electrical system

parts.name: Mounting brackets
parts.role: Locate and fasten the fascia, lamps and sensors to the vehicle structure

electronics: LED front fog lamps (left and right)
LED front direction indicator lamps (left and right)
Wiring harness connecting sensors and lamps to the vehicle electrical system
vehicle_interfaces: Bumper beam bolted to the front longitudinal members / crash boxes of the body structure
Bumper cover fastened via PA6-GF30 brackets to the body, front-end carrier, wings and headlamp area
Electrical connection of fog lamps, direction indicators and parking sensors to the vehicle wiring via the bumper harness
Parking sensors interface with the vehicle's parking-assist control unit
Fog lamps and direction indicators controlled by the vehicle lighting switch/body electronics
Lower grille opening supplies cooling air to the radiator/front-end module
